scheduler.start_condition: Wave-1 controller is terminal and all Wave-1 model services have stopped.
scheduler.mac_to_server_transfer: If direct download is unavailable, transfer only with sftp -l 4096 and preserve the same target/evidence identities.

acceptance: Hugging Face resolves the exact immutable revision
repository file count equals the official expanded tree
repository byte total equals the official expanded tree
every repository file has a retained local SHA-256
the evidence manifest and model SHA list have their own retained SHA-256 inventory
the evidence root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and not TERMINAL_REJECTED
failure: Any exception seals a fresh TERMINAL_REJECTED evidence root, retains a partial target without cleanup authorization, and requires a separately prefrozen recovery target.
cleanup: No successful or partial target may be deleted merely because the next step fails; comparisons/model-retention-policy.v1.json controls cleanup.
